tools.name: jira_search
tools.description: Find Jira issues with JQL, e.g. 'assignee = currentUser() AND sprint in openSprints()'. Returns key, summary, status, priority, assignee, sprint, last update.

comments.description: Include each issue's latest 5 comments: author, time and markdown body. JQL cannot filter by commenter; narrow by time (updated >= -1d) and read these.

next.description: The next value a previous search returned, to get the following page.

site.description: Site host, e.g. acme.atlassian.net. Default: the first signed-in site.

tools.name: jira_issue
tools.description: One Jira issue by key (ABC-123): its fields, description and newest comments as markdown, its recent field changes, and the transitions it can take next.

comments.description: How many of the newest comments to include, up to 50. Default 10; commentCount says how many there are.

tools.name: jira_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Jira issue. Write it in markdown.

tools.name: jira_transition
tools.description: Move a Jira issue through its workflow. Name a transition or the status it leads to; with neither, lists the transitions the issue can take now.

to.description: A transition's name or id, or the name of the status it leads to.

tools.name: jira_create
tools.description: Create a Jira issue; parent puts it under an epic. The description is markdown. A wrong type is answered with the project's types.

type.description: Issue type name, e.g. Epic, Bug, Story. Default Task.

fields.description: Other fields by id, as Jira's REST API takes them.

tools.name: jira_edit
tools.description: Change a Jira issue's fields; only those given change. The description is markdown and replaces the old one.

parent.description: Epic or issue key; empty takes it out.

assignee.description: An account id, or 'me'; empty unassigns.

fields.description: Other fields by id, as Jira's REST API takes them.

tools.name: jira_link
tools.description: Link two issues so 'key relation other' reads true, e.g. ABC-1 blocks ABC-2. A wrong relation is answered with the site's link types.

relation.description: As Jira words it, or a link type's name.

tools.name: jira_worklog
tools.description: Log time spent on a Jira issue, e.g. time '1h 30m'.
